clue.text: Acknowledging young lady in a shady nightclub

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the young lady is placed inside the words for a shady nightclub

parts.note: a dive is a seedy, disreputable bar or club
Miss is the title for a young unmarried woman

explanation.surface: Someone owns up to having been with a girl in a seedy club.
explanation.definitionFit: To be admissive is to be inclined to confess or concede, the same as owning up.

clue.text: Overdrawn-invested in costly tree

indicators.note: invested in means put inside, like money sunk into a venture, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: dear means expensive
OD is the bank-statement abbreviation for overdrawn

explanation.surface: Someone in the red has sunk money into an expensive tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The deodar is a Himalayan cedar, a large conifer.

clue.text: Models ladies' fashions

indicators.note: fashions as a verb means shapes or reworks, so the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fashion models show off women's clothing styles.
explanation.definitionFit: Ideals are perfect examples to copy, which is one sense of models.

clue.text: Plunder inflicts damage

explanation.surface: A looter wrecks things as well as stealing them.
explanation.definitionFit: Spoils are booty taken in war; to spoil something is to ruin or harm it.

clue.text: Game the archdeacon is playing

parts.note: an archdeacon is styled the Venerable, abbreviated Ven
taken as written
on means taking part, as a player on the field

explanation.surface: A senior clergyman joins in a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Venison is the meat of deer, a kind of game hunted for food.

clue.text: Quickly finish getting furniture stripped down

explanation.surface: Someone races through a job sanding the varnish from a table.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is literal: furniture stripped down has had its polish taken off.
explanation.definitionFit: To polish off is to consume or complete rapidly; stripped furniture has had its shiny coating removed.

clue.text: School cane may cause amusement

parts.note: a schoolmaster's cane is a stick for slapping, yet the word for knockabout comedy with pratfalls is built from those two ideas

explanation.surface: A teacher's punishment rod ends up being funny.
explanation.definitionFit: Boisterous physical comedy takes its name from a clown's paddle that made a loud smack.

clue.text: Government opponent and S I leave a Christian assembly

indicators.note: assembly means putting parts together in a new order, so the remaining letters are rearranged
leave means go away from, so one letter departs from the words that follow

explanation.surface: A rebel walks out of a church gathering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leave' takes I out of ACHRISTIAN, giving ACHRSTIAN, which 'assembly' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: One who rejects all state authority is a political rebel against rule.

clue.text: Dad gets nothing in return for material

parts.note: pop is an informal name for father

indicators.note: in return means coming back, so the word for nothing is read backwards

parts.note: nil means zero

explanation.surface: A father gets no reward for supplying fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Poplin is a plain-woven cotton cloth.

clue.text: Change one's mind and call

explanation.surface: Someone reconsiders and pays a visit.
explanation.definitionFit: To come round is to be persuaded to a new view, and also to drop in on someone.

clue.text: Light-fingered youngster

explanation.surface: A thieving child.
explanation.definitionFit: A nipper is old slang for a pickpocket or petty thief, and an everyday British word for a small child.

clue.text: Make fewer criticisms? Perfect!

explanation.surface: Someone is told to criticise less and praised as flawless.
explanation.walkthrough: Read in two parts, the first sense is fault plus less: less finding of faults.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawless has no defects at all, while finding fault less means criticising less.

clue.text: Companion over there has thick hair

parts.note: that points to something at a distance
CH is the abbreviation for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A friend across the room has a full head of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A mop of dense, untidy hair is jokingly likened to a roof of straw.

clue.text: Bound to support bad children

indicators.note: in a down entry the supporting piece sits below, so the jump comes after the word for bad

parts.note: off describes food that has gone bad
a bound is a leap, as is a spring

explanation.surface: Someone leaps to help naughty kids.
explanation.definitionFit: Offspring are a person's descendants, their sons and daughters.

clue.text: Pension for all the directors

parts.note: full means complete, with all included
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: A retirement fund is shared among every member of the board.
explanation.definitionFit: A pension in the sense of a boarding house includes all meals, the arrangement of lodging with every meal provided.

clue.text: Reeled around in shock

explanation.surface: Someone stumbled about after a nasty surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Staggered means both lurched unsteadily and astonished or amazed.

clue.text: It carries the genetic code in reverse also

indicators.note: in reverse means backwards, so the letters of the molecule's abbreviation are turned round

parts.note: DNA is the molecule carrying genetic information

explanation.surface: A molecule's code runs backwards as well.
explanation.definitionFit: The conjunction adding another item means the same as as well.

clue.text: A couple of sovereigns found in animal shelter

parts.note: two monarchs: R for rex and K for king

explanation.surface: Two gold coins turn up in a pet rescue centre.
explanation.walkthrough: Sovereigns suggests gold coins, but here they are rulers: R (Latin rex) and K (king).
explanation.definitionFit: Noah's vessel sheltered pairs of every creature from the flood.

clue.text: Took action, but not irreversibly

indicators.note: not irreversibly means the word can be turned round and stays unchanged, reading the same either way

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Someone acted, though it could still be undone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irreversibly' suggests a permanent step; read literally, the word is not changed by reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: The past tense of do means performed or carried out.

clue.text: Bet it's a cardiac irregularity

explanation.surface: A gambler's heart skips a beat over a wager.
explanation.definitionFit: A flutter is a small wager in British slang, and also a rapid irregular heartbeat.

clue.text: News about America is clearly portrayed

parts.note: info means information or news
c is short for circa, Latin for about
US stands for the United States

explanation.surface: A report on the States depicts things sharply.
explanation.definitionFit: A sharp photograph has its subject properly resolved by the lens.

clue.text: Deceive young Billy

explanation.surface: Trick a youngster called Billy.
explanation.walkthrough: Billy looks like a boy's name, but a billy is a male goat, whose young is a kid.
explanation.definitionFit: To kid is to tease or fool; a young goat is called a kid.

clue.text: Sudden urge to see one male heartthrob

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
the throb of the heart is the pulse

explanation.surface: A sudden desire to see an attractive man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartthrob' suggests an idol, but it is read literally as the beating of the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: An impulse is a spontaneous desire to act without thinking.

clue.text: Fodder for a prudent man about-1.50

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the wise man's word goes round the numerals

parts.note: a sage is a wise person
one and fifty in Roman numerals are I and L

explanation.surface: Animal feed bought by a careful man for one pound fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: 1.50 looks like a price, but it is 1 (I) and 50 (L).
explanation.definitionFit: Silage is grass or other green crops stored and fermented as winter feed for livestock.

clue.text: A kid should be free from constraint

parts.note: to kid is to tease

explanation.surface: A child ought to be allowed to run free.
explanation.definitionFit: Being relaxed and unconstrained is the military idea of standing easy.

clue.text: Caress results in apoplexy

explanation.surface: A tender touch brings on a seizure.
explanation.definitionFit: A stroke is a gentle pass of the hand, and also a sudden brain attack once called apoplexy.

clue.text: Calcium deposit in new wine — sweet wine

indicators.note: deposit in means put inside, so the element's symbol is lodged within the word for new wine

parts.note: must is unfermented grape juice, new wine
Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium

explanation.surface: A mineral build-up forms in young wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Muscat is a sweet dessert wine from the grape of that name.

clue.text: Say what you will, it's the way to cook a pig!

definitions.text: it's the way to cook a pig!

explanation.surface: Speak up, as one cooks a pig over a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is literal: put the pig on a spit.
explanation.definitionFit: To blurt out what you are holding back is the idiom; roasting a pig means skewering it on a rod.

clue.text: New editor created uproar

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh arrangement, so the letters of the word after it are reworked

explanation.surface: A newly appointed editor caused a stir.
explanation.definitionFit: To riot is to cause a violent public disturbance.

clue.text: Suddenly everyone united around Conservative leader

parts.note: all means everybody

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the word for united goes round the initial letter

parts.note: at one means in agreement

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Without warning, the whole party rallied behind the Tory chief.
explanation.definitionFit: Happening simultaneously and without warning means abruptly.

clue.text: And not even in poetry does her name appear

parts.note: nor means and not
e'en is the poetic contraction of even

explanation.surface: Her name never turns up in verse.
explanation.definitionFit: Noreen is a woman's first name.

clue.text: Blocks people circumscribed by dogmatic beliefs

indicators.note: circumscribed by means enclosed by, so the word for people sits inside the word for beliefs

parts.note: tenets are principles held as true
men means people

explanation.surface: Dogma hems people in.
explanation.definitionFit: Tenements are large blocks of rented flats.
